result.summary: The image shows a narrow, one-way residential street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian infrastructure at the intersection. While the narrow street width naturally limits traffic speed, the absence of crosswalks and the presence of parked cars near the corner create visibility and safety challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, providing no visual cue for drivers to expect pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are situated very close to the intersection corner, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

result.summary: This narrow residential street features sidewalks on both sides and a marked crosswalk with a curb ramp. The environment is naturally low-speed due to the narrow roadway and street trees, though the crosswalk markings are significantly faded.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Roadway Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and minor potholes in the asphalt at the crossing point could present a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway near the curb ramp

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the faded zebra markings with high-visibility thermoplastic to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Patch and resurface the degraded areas of the roadway at the intersection to ensure a level walking surface.

interventions.title: Intersection Control Signage
interventions.description: Install a stop sign or 'Yield to Pedestrians' sign to clarify right-of-way at the crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and mature street trees providing some traffic calming effect. However, the environment lacks any marked pedestrian crossings, traffic control devices, or bike infrastructure, and parked vehicles on the right side create potential sightline obstructions for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely within the visible area.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: A continuous line of parked vehicles along the right curb blocks the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The environment is a narrow, low-speed urban intersection with mixed-use buildings but lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, traffic control signs, or pedestrian signals visible at this corner.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The building on the corner is situated directly at the sidewalk edge, creating a blind spot for vehicles turning onto the main street and pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, the corner of the pizza shop building.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks fails to alert drivers to pedestrian crossing locations and does not provide a designated path for walkers.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate the flow of traffic at this intersection.
